services.name: fly fishing
services.desc: Let our 24 years of heli-fishing experience take you to some spectacular fly fishing for bull trout and coho salmon. Imagine taking a helicopter into a remote coastal river for a day of fun-filled fly fishing enjoyment and spectacular scenery. Come experience heli-fishing in British Columbia - Remote fly fishing at it's finest! Prices do not include 5% GST Tax or gratuities. Clients will also be required to purchase a BC Freshwater Fishing License and applicable tags. Group trips of 4 or more will have a 20% gratuity added to the trip.
